description: This file defines the BookingAuditViewerService class, which handles fetching, enriching, and formatting booking audit logs, including support for rescheduled bookings and impersonation details.

classes.name: BookingAuditViewerService
classes.description: Service class for viewing, enriching, and formatting booking audit logs, including handling reschedules and impersonation.

methods.name: getAuditLogsForBooking
methods.description: Fetches audit logs for a specific booking, enriches them, and includes reschedule info if applicable.

methods.name: enrichAuditLog
methods.description: Enriches a single audit log with actor info and formatted display data.

methods.name: buildFallbackAuditLog
methods.description: Creates a minimal fallback log entry when enrichment fails.

methods.name: buildRescheduledFromLog
methods.description: Constructs a 'rescheduled from' log entry for bookings created via reschedule.

methods.name: enrichImpersonator
methods.description: Enriches impersonator info if present in the log context.

methods.name: mergeDataRequirements
methods.description: Merges multiple data requirement objects into one.

methods.name: collectDataRequirements
methods.description: Collects all data requirements from audit logs and action services.

methods.name: buildEnrichmentDataStore
methods.description: Builds a data store by bulk-fetching required data based on requirements.
